title: Destination C1&C2 · Unit 14 · P · Word formation · tr.119

parts.name: P · Word formation · tr.119
parts.instructions: Write a word with en- from exercise O in the correct form in each gap.

items.stem: Are you really thinking of ____ in the army?
items.explanation_vi: Enlist là nhập ngũ, ở dạng V-ing.

items.stem: This new software should ____ us to speed up the distribution process no end.
items.explanation_vi: Enable somebody to do là giúp ai làm được.

items.stem: There's no point having a law if the police can't ____ it.
items.explanation_vi: Enforce a law là thi hành luật.

items.stem: We were completely ____ by journalists and photographers and couldn't get to the car.
items.explanation_vi: Encircle là vây quanh; ở đây ở dạng bị động.

items.stem: The destruction of the rainforests is ____ the survival of a number of species.
items.explanation_vi: Endanger là đe dọa; thì hiện tại tiếp diễn.

items.stem: Can we ____ the photo so we can see their faces in a bit more detail?
